To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The use of the feedback letters in the Master in Higher Teaching allowed to promote a learning oriented assessment, which in turn promoted deep and relevant learning experiences, as well as the motivation of the participants, and the development of the teachers investigators in terms of their professional development.
feedback letters are a tool for promoting learning oriented assessment processes.
the use of feedback letters as a tool for learning oriented assessment has an impact on the students motivation and learning as well as on the teacher s professional development.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of feedback processes in a learning oriented approach.
the promotion of a reflective approach to assessment in the University.
the analysis and improvement of the teaching practice of the participants and with the promotion of their personal and professional development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the feedback letters allowed promoting learning experiences beyond the strategic level.
the feedback letters were an excellent tool for the development of learning oriented assessment.
the feedback process has had a positive influence on both students and teachers and has promoted learning oriented assessment processes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to promote the idea of a feedback process as a learning experience, and that the learning oriented assessment should be understood as an integral part of the learning experience.
the feedback processes are a key to a learning oriented assessment.
the students were able to learn from the feedback process and that the teachers were able to reflect on their teaching practices and their own learning processes.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of personal feedback letters as a tool to promote a more learning oriented assessment process, is a powerful tool that has a positive impact on the learning process of the participants and on their motivation.
the process of feedback is a crucial element for the development of learningoriented assessment.
the feedback process has a strong impact on the emotional and professional sphere of the participants.
